through_line.name: le diaphragme
through_line.progression: presente calme en bloc un (trampoline qui respire sous les poumons) -> irrite et spasme en bloc deux (contraction d'un coup sec, aspiration brusque) -> consequence en bloc trois (l'air claque contre la glotte qui se ferme : le hic) -> origine en bloc quatre (le reflexe s'entrainait deja dans le ventre maternel)
through_line.resolution: le bloc final explique d'ou vient ce reflexe absurde : un entrainement respiratoire d'avant la naissance — la boucle du hook (soixante-huit ans de hoquet) se referme sur un reflexe plus vieux que ta premiere respiration

blocks.vo_line: Un homme a eu le hoquet soixante-huit ans. Pour comprendre, direction ton diaphragme : le grand muscle en dôme, tendu comme un trampoline juste sous tes poumons.
blocks.through_line_state: presente et calme : le dome-trampoline rebondit doucement au rythme de la respiration
shots: WIDE static establishing: the chest cavern; the sandy dome muscle bounces gently like a trampoline while the two balloon-lungs inflate and deflate in a calm rhythm
MEDIUM low angle: the young person slides in at the side with a hand on their belly; a sudden hic-bounce jolts their shoulders up
CLOSE-UP: the young person hiccups again — cheeks puff, eyes blink wide, a small startled hop
EXTREME CLOSE-UP slow push-in: the taut dome muscle surface, quivering slightly with tiny ripples
MEDIUM: the rounded lungs-and-dome badge swings in and settles beside the dome with a bounce, two sparkles popping around it

blocks.vo_line: Avale trop vite ou bois un soda glacé : le muscle s'agace et se contracte d'un coup sec en aspirant l'air brusquement vers tes poumons.
blocks.through_line_state: irrite : le dome fremit, puis claque vers le bas d'un coup sec — le spasme aspire l'air d'un trait
shots: CLOSE-UP static: the mint soda glass pops in beside the windpipe and fizzy bubbles race up and pop one after another
MEDIUM high angle with a slow tilt down: three round air-gulps tumble down the windpipe into the chest one after another
EXTREME CLOSE-UP: the dome muscle's edge twitches as tiny irritation sparkles crackle along it
MEDIUM static: the dome SNAPS downward flat with a deep jolt and both balloon-lungs suddenly balloon wide
CLOSE-UP low angle: the stretched lungs wobble back with a squeak, air sparkles swirling inside

blocks.vo_line: Sauf que là-haut, ta glotte panique et claque la porte en une fraction de seconde. L'air freiné pile dessus fait vibrer tes cordes vocales : hic.
blocks.through_line_state: consequence du spasme : l'air aspire par le dome fonce vers le haut et s'ecrase contre la glotte fermee
shots: WIDE static establishing: the throat tube; the two mint glottis doors stand slightly open at the top, gentle air sparkles drifting through
MEDIUM: a rush of round air-blobs races up the tube toward the doors, one after another, faster and faster
CLOSE-UP: the two doors SLAM shut with a sharp clap; the leading air-blob squashes flat against them
EXTREME CLOSE-UP slow push-in: the two taut cords on the closed doors quiver rapidly with tight vibration lines
MEDIUM low angle: one air-blob tumbles back down, deflated, as the doors ease slightly ajar and settle

blocks.vo_line: Ce réflexe étrange date du ventre de ta mère : les bébés hoquettent avant même de respirer — abonne-toi, demain on passe aux fameux bâillements contagieux.
blocks.through_line_state: origine revelee : le meme spasme du dome s'entrainait deja avant la naissance — la boucle du hook se referme
shots: WIDE static establishing: the soft round pocket; the small curled silhouette floats gently, bobbing in the pale liquid
CLOSE-UP: the silhouette's tiny chest gives a soft hic-bounce and a stream of little bubbles rises
EXTREME CLOSE-UP: the bubbles pop against the pocket wall one by one with soft rings
MEDIUM: the young person slides in beside the pocket scene, points at it, then taps their own chest twice and nods to camera
CLOSE-UP low angle: the young person points at the viewer, the rounded sandy bell pops in and rings with two sparkles, and they wink
